name: v2.66.0 (2026-11-04)
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 7d1d3f0191fd5d500b02e58dee2bf6d7adc1b967 -->

## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* [GHSA-m5vj-8mcw-82qx](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-m5vj-8mcw-82qx) (high): `web_fetch_tool` and the `WebFetch` capability's local fallback re-indented a JSON response on the event loop before applying the returned-content limit, so a deeply nested document within the download size limit could expand to hundreds of times its size, using large amounts of memory and delaying other work in the same process. You are affected if an attacker can choose or influence the URLs the tool fetches. Provider-native web fetching is not affected. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-mfx5-pc32-32m8](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-mfx5-pc32-32m8) (high): The `private_key` pattern in Pydantic AI Harness's secret redaction backtracked exponentially on crafted text, so a few hundred characters that begin like a private key could occupy the event loop for minutes or longer. You are affected if you use `redact_secrets` or `secret_data()` with the `private_key` pattern, which is included by default, on text an attacker can influence. Fixed in `pydantic-ai-harness` 0.66.0.
* [GHSA-5fj9-5pjw-vpwc](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-5fj9-5pjw-vpwc) (medium): The cloud-metadata blocklist that URL downloads check did not include Tencent Cloud's instance metadata address `169.254.0.23`, so someone who can supply a URL the application downloads could have it fetch the instance's temporary role credentials. You are affected if you run on Tencent Cloud and allow local URLs, through `force_download='allow-local'` on a `FileUrl` or `web_fetch_tool(allow_local_urls=True)`. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-jp94-mmr3-2pvv](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-jp94-mmr3-2pvv) (medium): With OpenTelemetry instrumentation enabled for embedding models, embedding spans recorded the `extra_headers` and `extra_body` embedding settings, so credentials passed through them could be read by anyone with access to the exported traces. You are affected if you instrument embedding models and pass secrets through those settings. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`). Restrict access to historical traces and rotate credentials they exposed.
* [GHSA-7494-925c-rrxv](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-7494-925c-rrxv) (medium): For models whose profile requires tool schemas without `$defs` and `$ref`, a small tool schema whose definitions reference one another repeatedly expanded exponentially when inlined on the event loop, which can take minutes of CPU time and gigabytes of memory. You are affected if you serve such a model through the AG-UI adapter, where clients submit their own frontend tool schemas. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-484x-x9m4-62cj](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-484x-x9m4-62cj) (medium): Decision models (`DecisionModel` subclasses such as `OpenAIDecisionsModel`, and `TypeSafeModel`) resolved every `$ref` in a tool's argument schema again at each place it appears, so a small crafted schema could take exponential time and memory on the event loop. You are affected if you use a decision model from v2.46.0 onward with tools whose schemas an attacker can supply, most directly through an AG-UI endpoint. Fixed in v2.66.0 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-r879-rxgj-3g75](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-r879-rxgj-3g75) (medium): The Vercel AI and AG-UI adapters took time that grows with the square of the number of parts to load a submitted message, on the event loop, so a single request could delay other work in the same process. You are affected if you pass client-submitted conversations to `VercelAIAdapter` or `AGUIAdapter`. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-4cj4-hgwf-4hc4](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-4cj4-hgwf-4hc4) (medium): When message history was serialized and loaded again, a tool result containing a JSON object in the serialized shape of one of Pydantic AI's file types was rebuilt as that file. A third party who controls data a tool returns could use this to make the application download a URL on its local network, or make the model provider read an `s3://` object or uploaded file with the application's credentials. You are affected if tool results can contain data third parties control, that history is stored and reloaded, held on the server by a UI adapter, or carried by Temporal, DBOS or Prefect durable execution, and your model or its provider fetches or resolves such files; the advisory lists which do. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`).
* [GHSA-5ppx-9jq6-6pmw](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-5ppx-9jq6-6pmw) (low): `allowed_domains` on the local web-fetch tool, and `PlaywrightBrowser` egress policies whose allowlist bounds every request kind, looked a refused hostname up in DNS before rejecting it, so data encoded in the hostname could reach that domain's nameserver. Domain lists are now checked before resolution. You are affected only if you rely on such an allowlist while the model processes content untrusted parties can influence. Fixed in v2.66.0 and v1.107.10 (`pydantic-ai`, `pydantic-ai-slim`), and `pydantic-ai-harness` 0.66.0.
* [GHSA-mgmv-r532-pg36](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-mgmv-r532-pg36) (medium): An `MCP` capability configured with a server URL and no explicit `id` derived its identifier from the URL's hostname and last path segment, and the AG-UI and Vercel AI adapters sent that identifier to the frontend with MCP Apps tool results, so a credential in that segment could reach users of the chat frontend. This affects v2.57.0 up to but not including v2.60.0, and was fixed in v2.60.0; it is disclosed with this batch. Rotate MCP server credentials that were carried in the URL path.

### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Call Anthropic's `20260209` web tools directly on the Anthropic API when citations are requested by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12278
* Apply `FunctionToolset(requires_approval=True)` to `Tool` instances passed to the toolset by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12378
* Re-resolve realtime session instructions before each model turn and deliver their changes as appends by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11930
* Recognize `SummarizingCompaction(keep_user_messages=True)` copies only by the marker on their text by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12316

### 🚀 Features
* Add `OpenSandbox` for self-hosted agent workspaces by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11841
* Add Azure Durable Task durability to `pydantic_ai_harness` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11332
* Add `Pixeltable` tools and memory storage to Harness by @pierrebrunelle in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9369
* Add `RenderSandbox` to run agent workspaces in Render sandboxes by @ojusave in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10238
* Add `include_instructions` to the `MCP` capability so server instructions can be left out of the agent's instructions by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12269
* Re-resolve realtime session instructions before each model turn and deliver their changes as appends by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11930
* Report xAI Grok Voice speech timing as `segment` timestamps with `output_speech_timestamps` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11782
* Add a `retries` field to `SummarizingCompaction` by @gouyu-hou in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12315
* Add `Workspace.authority` and `AuthorityWorkspace` for workspaces whose files the operator does not control by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11836
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Stop `ModalSandbox` failing with `AttributeError` on Modal 1.6, which removed `FilesystemExecutionError` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12247
* Call Anthropic's `20260209` web tools directly on the Anthropic API when citations are requested by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12278
* Add streaming support to `CohereModel` by @Julien-ser in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/6100
* Release run dependencies after exceptions by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11255
* Preserve extra keys in `tool_search` and `load_capability` message history by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7933
* Inline `$defs` in tool schemas for GLM-5.3 on Together, Nebius, Fireworks, Vercel, Ollama, Hugging Face, Cerebras, Mistral and OpenAI-compatible gateways by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12138
* Keep `RepoContext` from following symlinks out of the working directory or to files that aren't instruction files by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12044
* Reject approvals for tool calls a server-held history isn't waiting on under `manage_message_history='server'` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12313
* Apply `FunctionToolset(requires_approval=True)` to `Tool` instances passed to the toolset by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12378
* Recognize `SummarizingCompaction(keep_user_messages=True)` copies only by the marker on their text by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12316
* Keep on-demand capabilities loaded from code across `SummarizingCompaction`, `SlidingWindowCompaction` and `RelevanceCompaction`, recording every removed load again as a `CapabilityLoadDeltaPart` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12270
* Keep earlier tool-call turns byte-stable when a later response thinks in `openai_chat_send_back_thinking_parts='field'` mode by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12309
* Keep a code-loaded capability's instructions across instruction windows by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12304
* Write `RepairToolArguments` repairs back to the `ToolCallPart` in history by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12319
* Take user constraints only from the user's messages in `AnthropicModel.compact_messages()`'s focus prompt by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11915
* Floor the tiered escalation estimate at the surviving text so a cheap anchor cannot hide the rest of the chain by @gouyu-hou in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12341
* Close `SqliteStepStore` and `SqliteMediaStore` connections whose WAL switch fails on a locked database by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12147
* Fix instrumented embedding spans missing the `embeddings` attribute when `include_content=True` by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8295
* Stop keying `OpenAIChatModel`'s batch hint, OpenAI realtime models and harness `Advisor` on provider names by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11796
